Kerala High Court Quashes Assembly Ruckus Case Against Former MLA

The Kerala High Court has quashed the last remaining case against a former UDF MLA concerning a 2015 assembly ruckus. The court's decision applies to the case registered against the former MLA for his alleged involvement in the incident. This action by the High Court effectively closes the legal proceedings related to the assembly brawl.
